card.name: Small words in historical and religious narrative
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as his, of, a and and in general-web history, religion and story text, often just before a noun or name continues. Examples are 'with his family' and 'the Story of Creation'.

modes.label: His before a family or object noun
modes.description: The word his follows a verb or preposition in a story about a historical figure, just before a noun.
modes.example: left Arabia along with<< his>> family due to the ongoing threat of Yaz

modes.label: Of or and inside titles and names
modes.description: A joining word sits inside a book title, name or descriptive phrase about ancient or religious subjects.
modes.example: the Story<< of>> Creation. [2d edition], University
